newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria June CPI falls to 28.8 pct y/y from 31.0.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria June CPI falls to 28.8 pct y/y from 31.0.

text.p: Nigeria's year-on-year consumer price inflation fell to 28.8 percent in June from 31.0 percent in May, the Federal Office of Statistics (FOS) said on Tuesday.
Month-on-month inflation dropped to 2.8 percent in June from 5.5 percent in May.
"Food was largely responsible for all price increases during the period under review," the FOS said.
"Prices of staples, vegetables and fruits recorded higher price increases. On the other hand, the prices of meat, fish and processed food fell in some areas."
Battling inflation was key to the tight fiscal policy set out by military ruler General Sani Abacha.
